headline: Connect Aeotec devices through local radios
intro: Use Home Assistant's Z-Wave and Zigbee integrations with Aeotec devices. Both device types work locally and require the matching Z-Wave or Zigbee stick; status updates and control happen locally in Home Assistant.
highlights: Connect Aeotec Z-Wave devices through the Z-Wave integration and a Z-Wave stick
Connect Aeotec Zigbee devices through the Zigbee integration and a Zigbee stick
Keep device status updates and control local to Home Assistant

flow.title: From Aeotec device to Home Assistant
stages: Choose the device's Z-Wave or Zigbee radio
Connect the matching Z-Wave or Zigbee stick
Use the Z-Wave or Zigbee integration for local status and control
